title: AckNackReceipt.v1
description: The outcome of a worker completing (ack) or failing (nack) a work item — projected from the FleetLedger task after ack_task/nack_task. ack => succeeded; nack(retryable) => retry_wait; nack(non-retryable or max attempts) => dead. Carries result refs or the error.

resulting_status.description: queued = requeued for retry (the runtime does retry_wait->queued and clears the lease)
